items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: The interviewee confirms that 'he' (the subject of the previous question, not the interviewee) played with Clayton, but does not state that he himself played with or knew Clayton personally.

ctx.x: Do you know his address? Did you get his address?
Doesn't matter. Yeah, I can get his address. Did he play with Clayton? Did he play for a while with Clayton?

Oh, yeah. A few years ago? Yeah, I think he did, yes. Okay, someone, I think I'm gonna get him. And you know, I used to play with Sheik too, you know. So many bands I played with, I can't remember. You know, right off here, I got to write it all down. Yeah, Sheik and I played together for years. Yeah, all down in St. Bernard, the ratio, and Delicore Island, all down there. Played with Sheik, you know. Yeah, he had a nice little band. And I played with Kit Howard down in Grand Island. Used to play with him down…
